reusable_owners.limit: Structural source population, not reviewed meaning.
Unsigned declarations preserve pending, disputed, unsupported and declarations_recorded states; no gold eligibility.
Migrates blank custody drafts; no answers or exposure evidence are supplied.
Runtime qualification and actual-source replay remain pending per its guide; explicit unary FOL/TDFOL definition only.
Fixed definition review domain; positive authentication is not statutory gold admission.
Qualification not established by this planning phase; alias assumed, representative lookup only, not a general norm-use or per-occurrence governing review.
Exact endpoint-preserving transport does not establish legal meaning.
Existing seven-facet canonical JSON comparison; richer reviewed semantics need supported targets and separate metrics.
Existing narrow shared unary profile; native compilation does not establish legal correctness.

source_and_review_requirements: Retain immutable source release, acquisition, original bytes, source-view profile and independently retained commitments.
Bind exact source version, physical occurrence and half-open Unicode/UTF8 selectors; repeated text remains distinct.
Preserve the complete selected population, controls, inherited context and unresolved dependencies.
Review governing scope and applicability separately from publication edition and extraction success.
Seal source-first meaning targets and retain actual exposure evidence before candidate inspection.
Retain authorized independent legal/formal decisions, disagreements, alternatives and identity/competence evidence.
Bind intake declarations to the exact typed interpretation through supported correspondence; shared text or signatures alone do not suffice.
Review each added combined meaning in its proper domain; original definition decisions do not approve added uses or aliases.
Identify the downstream owner and policy for gold eligibility; intake or review assessment alone admits nothing.
representation_requirements: Preserve definition operator/body, quantifiers, sorts, arity, ordered arguments and actor/action/object/recipient roles.
Preserve modality, polarity, conditions, exceptions, attachments, numeric limits and temporal qualifiers.
Bind each actual use to its governing definition under reviewed scope and applicability; retain ambiguity.
Unsupported material stays explicit; an opaque whole-body atom is not complete statutory meaning.
Do not force an actual norm into the existing definition-alias profile or merge senses because their labels match.

metric_contract.measure: Exact identity and explicit included, pending, disputed, unsupported or out-of-scope disposition.
Independent complete decisions; pending, disputed and unsupported remain visible, with no inferred eligibility.
Complete correct candidate present before ranking or budget pruning.
Exact full ordered typed IR; missing, duplicate, malformed, abstained and unverifiable rows get no match credit.
Omissions/additions and wrong operators, roles, attachments, scope or applicability; report selected-population coverage alongside.
Exact endpoints/origins, scope-valid senses, arguments and per-occurrence governing resolution.
Separate syntax, lossless lowering, actual native execution and reviewed source correspondence; unsupported cases remain counted.
Expected conditional consequences, without inconsistent-premise or vacuous-proof credit.
Actual build, artifacts, source traceability, declared assumptions and changed-versus-clean rebuild agreement.
Report decoded, abstained, missing, duplicate, malformed, unverifiable and overflow counts separately; score after target-free generation.

exit_gate_interpretation: These are review requirements, not executable predicates or a task/admission engine. Pilot acceptance requires independently reviewed complete meaning with no material omission/addition, complete graph integrity and actual supported Lean evidence. Low loss, self-reconstruction, syntax and compilation cannot substitute for that review.
runtime_materialization: A future immutable owner-bound execution manifest resolves actual references and outcomes. This authored specification remains unchanged and supplies no runtime, review, gold, queue or admission authority.
